info.name: Cyware Orchestrate (CO) Open Code Snippets API

params.name: unique_id
params.description: Pass the unique ID of the code snippet to retrieve the details. You can use the **Get Code Snippet List** endpoint to retrieve the unique ID of a code snippet.

items.docs: Returns details of a specific code snippet.

params.name: page
params.description: Pass the page number to retrieve the code snippets list.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Pass the number of items to retrieve  per page.

params.name: q
params.description: Pass the title to search for a code snippet.

items.docs: Returns the list of code snippets.
